cd /workspace

ls -la /app/merged_users.parquet /app/conflicts.json
echo
echo "=== merged parquet ==="
python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, pyarrow.parquet as pq, json, re

df = pd.read_parquet('/app/merged_users.parquet')
print(df.to_string())
print("\ndtypes:\n", df.dtypes)
print("columns:", list(df.columns))
print("schema:", pq.read_schema('/app/merged_users.parquet'))

assert list(df.columns) == ['user_id','name','email','created_date','status'], list(df.columns)
assert len(df) == 4
assert df['user_id'].tolist() == [101,102,103,104]
assert str(df['user_id'].dtype) == 'int64', df['user_id'].dtype
for d in df['created_date']:
    assert re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}', str(d)), d

expected = {
 101: ('John Doe','john@a.com','2024-01-15','active'),
 102: ('Jane Smith','jane@a.com','2024-02-20','inactive'),
 103: ('Bob Wilson','bob@b.com','2024-03-01','active'),
 104: ('Alice Brown','alice@c.com','2024-04-01','active'),
}
for _, r in df.iterrows():
    got = (r['name'], r['email'], r['created_date'], r['status'])
    assert got == expected[int(r['user_id'])], (int(r['user_id']), got, expected[int(r['user_id'])])
print("\n✅ parquet checks passed")

report = json.load(open('/app/conflicts.json'))
print("\n=== conflicts.json ===")
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
assert set(report) == {'total_conflicts','conflicts'}
assert report['total_conflicts'] == len(report['conflicts']) == 3
for c in report['conflicts']:
    assert set(c) == {'user_id','field','values','selected'}
    assert c['user_id'] == 101
    assert c['selected'] == expected[101][['name','email','created_date','status'].index(c['field'])]
    assert len(c['values']) >= 2
fields = [c['field'] for c in report['conflicts']]
assert fields == ['name','email','created_date'], fields
print("\n✅ conflicts checks passed")
PY
